name: Head Bop Animation
blurb: One photo in: you lean back, point at the lens and nod on every beat. Add more photos for a lineup.

prompts.label: Template prompt
prompts.text: Use the photo as the main character and keep them exactly as photographed: same face, hair, skin tone, body shape and outfit. They stand in front of a plain dark grey pleated curtain, lit softly from the front, knees up in frame. They do the headbop to a slowed phonk beat, every move landing on the kick: (1) a deep lean back, chin up, one palm held out, the head still nodding; (2) they snap forward and point straight at the camera, eyebrows raised; (3) an open-palm shrug with both hands while the head bobs side to side; (4) a hard nod forward on every beat to the end, a little smirk. The feet stay planted and the head carries the rhythm. Phone on a tripod, one continuous shot, vertical 9:16. Slowed phonk beat with heavy bass and cowbell in the audio, no vocals. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.

prompts.label: Head bop animation â the yellow tee
prompts.text: Use the photo as the main character and keep them exactly as photographed: same face, hair, skin tone, body shape and outfit. They stand close to a floor-length dark grey satin curtain that fills the whole background, bright even light from the front. To a slowed phonk beat, every move on the kick: (1) they lean back so far they nearly tip over, one hand flung out to the side, mouth open; (2) they spring upright and jab a finger straight into the lens twice; (3) they spread both palms in a wide "what?" shrug, head bobbing; (4) they lean in toward the camera and nod hard, eyebrows up, then step back with both palms out. Feet planted, the head always on the beat. Phone on a tripod at chest height, full body in frame, one continuous shot, vertical 9:16. Slowed phonk beat with heavy bass in the audio, no vocals. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.

prompts.label: Head bop animation â the wig and shades
prompts.text: Use the photo as the main character and keep their face, skin tone and body shape exactly as photographed. Give them a big shaggy light-brown wig and black sunglasses, and keep their own top. They stand in front of a black curtain with a plain white ceiling just visible above it. The clip jump-cuts on every beat of a slowed phonk track between deadpan poses, the head nodding between each one: arms crossed and chin up; two-hand finger guns at the lens; one arm raised in a flex; a slow head tilt to one side; stepping half out of frame to the left and back in. Each pose holds for one beat, the framing jumps slightly with each cut. Phone on a tripod, waist up to full body, vertical 9:16. Slowed phonk beat with heavy bass in the audio, no vocals. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.

prompts.label: Head bop animation â the cat lineup
prompts.text: One to four reference photos, one character each: a pet or a person. Keep every face, fur colour, markings and hairstyle exactly as photographed and never swap them. Each character appears as a cut-out head-and-shoulders photo, and they stand shoulder to shoulder in one row, in the order the photos were added, on a dark charcoal background under a soft spotlight. With fewer than four photos, the same characters repeat to fill a row of four. To a slowed phonk beat, the camera slides slowly along the row from left to right while each head bops in turn on the kick: a quick nod down and up with a tilt; then the camera slides back the other way and every head bops together on the last beats. Close framing, the row fills the screen, vertical 9:16. Slowed phonk beat with heavy bass in the audio, no vocals. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.
